reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down Europe's largest airline, Ryanair. As we do more breakdowns, we start to look for patterns of successful business models that succeed across different industries. Ryanair is another case study in low-cost shared economies of scale.

key_points.text: To break down Ryanair, I'm joined by Holland Advisors’ founder and portfolio manager, Andrew Hollingworth.
On this episode, we talk about what makes airlines such a difficult industry for investors.
Now, one quick note before we transition to the episode.
